# COSR.AI

> > Free cosmetic batch code checker and expiry date calculator for verifying production dates and shelf life of beauty products from major brands.

COSR.AI helps consumers verify the freshness and safety of cosmetics by decoding batch codes from brands like MAC Cosmetics, Clinique, Estée Lauder, Lancôme, Chanel, Nivea, and others. The platform provides manufacturing date verification, PAO (Period After Opening) tracking, and expiry date calculations for skincare and makeup products.

## Key Topics

- Batch code verification
- Cosmetic expiry dates
- Manufacturing date decoding
- Product freshness checking
- PAO (Period After Opening)
- Beauty product safety
- Skincare expiration
- Major beauty brands: MAC Cosmetics, Clinique, Estée Lauder, Lancôme, Chanel, Clarins, Shiseido, Nivea
- Luxury cosmetics (LVMH brands)
- Retailers: Sephora, Ulta, Nordstrom

## Main Tools

- [COSR.AI - Free Cosmetic Batch Code Checker & Expiry Date Calculator](https://cosr.ai/): Homepage for COSR.AI cosmetic batch code checker and expiry calculator

## Brand Batch Code Checkers

- [MAC Cosmetics Batch Code Checker - Verify Production Date & Expiry](https://cosr.ai/brands/mac): MAC Cosmetics batch code checker for production and expiry verification
- [Nivea Batch Code Checker - Verify Production Date & Expiry](https://cosr.ai/brands/nivea): Nivea skincare batch code checker by Beiersdorf AG Germany
- [Benefit Cosmetics Batch Code Checker - Verify Production Date & Expiry](https://cosr.ai/brands/benefit-cosmetics): Benefit Cosmetics (LVMH) batch code checker for makeup verification
